justification: The evidence supports attributing accountable decision-making to the AI-assisted process. It explicitly documents that human reviewers make the final decision, records their rationales, and outlines formal escalation paths to a Senior Claims Reviewer in case of disagreements, alongside a reconsideration process for customers.
evidence_used: The documented procedure assigns the final case-level decision to the claims reviewer.
Human reviewers determine the final disposition of individual claims.
Disagreements between the model recommendation and the reviewer are routed to an organisational role identified as Senior Claims Reviewer.
Reviewers enter a free-text rationale when finalising a disposition.
Customers may request reconsideration of an adverse disposition.
limitations: The actual criteria used by the Senior Claims Reviewer to resolve disagreements are not detailed in the provided evidence.
There is no information on how the Model Operations team's maintenance activities impact decision-making accountability.
